title: Why Whales, Sharks and Orcas Keep Killing Doug (Ocean Predator Marathon)
card: NOTHING IN THE OCEAN LIKES DOUG
intro: Doug has followed a sperm whale into the dark, watched a shark flee an orca, and been handed dinner by a false killer whale. Five trips, back to back. In the ocean, everything is somebody's meal. Doug is usually the garnish.
description: Five full episodes back to back: how deep a sperm whale really dives, why the great white flees orcas, why false killer whales hand over their kills, the creepiest octopus at every depth, and how each step of the ocean food chain kills Doug. Real science, cartoon deaths.
